# #equilibria
::: {.lead}
Game theory, decision-making, simulation, AI/ML and the data behind them,
in four courses of topic areas, with R examples throughout.
:::
:::

## What this is

#equilibria is an open collection of tutorials on game theory,
decision-making, simulation, AI/ML and the data behind them, with runnable R
examples. The tutorials are arranged in four courses, and each course is
divided into topic areas: eight per course, 32 in all. Work through a course
topic by topic, or go straight to a topic or a single tutorial; every page
stands on its own. The executable examples are teaching demonstrations, not
validated scientific or operational tools.

## Who this is for

Students and researchers in economics, biology, computer science and the
social sciences who want to see game-theoretic and statistical ideas worked
through in code. Course 1 assumes basic R and school-level algebra. Courses 2
and 4 build on it; Course 3 can also be taken on its own.

## The four courses

::: {.card-grid .course-cards}

::: {.card}
::: {.kicker}
Course 1 · Introductory
:::
### [Foundations of Game Theory](courses/course1-game-theory/index.qmd)
Equilibrium concepts and the canonical games, decisions under uncertainty, evolutionary, cooperative, behavioural and network games, and the history behind them. 8 topics<span class="count-chip"> · <span data-topic-sum="foundations classical-games decision-theory evolutionary-gt cooperative-gt behavioral-gt network-games history-of-gt-mathematics"></span> tutorials</span>.
:::

::: {.card}
::: {.kicker}
Course 2 · Intermediate
:::
### [Mechanisms, Behaviour & Ethics](courses/course2-mechanisms-behaviour/index.qmd)
Designing the rules of the game, auctions, behaviour in the lab and the field, incentives in blockchains, ethics, and cases where theory meets reality. 8 topics<span class="count-chip"> · <span data-topic-sum="mechanism-design auction-theory-deep-dive behavioral-economics experimental-economics cryptography-and-gt ethics-and-game-theory ethics-applications case-studies"></span> tutorials</span>.
:::

::: {.card}
::: {.kicker}
Course 3 · Advanced
:::
### [Mathematical & Statistical Methods](courses/course3-methods/index.qmd)
Linear algebra, optimisation, information theory, statistics, Bayesian and causal inference, econometrics and network science: the toolkit behind the models. 8 topics<span class="count-chip"> · <span data-topic-sum="linear-algebra-matrix optimization-numerical-methods information-theory statistical-foundations bayesian-methods causal-inference time-series-econometrics network-science"></span> tutorials</span>.
:::

::: {.card}
::: {.kicker}
Course 4 · Specialist
:::
### [Simulation, AI & Data Practice](courses/course4-simulation-ai-data/index.qmd)
Monte Carlo and agent-based simulation, machine learning and multi-agent AI, public data, visualisation, reproducible workflows and R packages. 8 topics<span class="count-chip"> · <span data-topic-sum="simulations ml-and-gt ai-ml-foundations-and-applications public-apis-and-datasets real-world-data-applications visualization-and-communication reproducibility-open-science r-package-development"></span> tutorials</span>.
:::
